format_cpp_code: format C++ source code using clang-format and return the formatted output
clean_cpp_preprocessor_directives: clean C++ preprocessor directives like include, ifdef, ifndef, define, if, else, endif from code
extract_cpp_function_name: extract the function name from a C++ function definition string or token list
extract_cpp_function_arguments: extract C++ function argument names and types from a function definition string
detokenize_cpp_code: detokenize C++ code back to source text and fix macro define spacing
